title: Assert the follower heading correction converges without overshoot
summary: The staircase turn test in the navigation suite now checks that the heading error shrinks on every pure-yaw tick and that yaw commands stop once the heading is inside the gate. This restates the no-overshoot property of the replaced forward-only test under bank commands.
next: Review and merge the bank-conforming follower after green CI.
reason: The change adds one CPU test assertion. Runtime sources, checkpoint bytes, the approved robot, acceptance gates and roadmap markers remain unchanged.
